name: google-drive
description: Use Google Drive as one unified Google file plugin for search, file organization, sharing, and Google Docs, Google Sheets, and Google Slides workflows

setup.notice: Google does not support automatic client registration. You must provide your own OAuth client credentials.
steps: In the Google Cloud console, enable the Google Drive API and the Google Drive MCP API
Add Devin's OAuth callback URL as an authorized redirect URI
Enter the OAuth client ID and secret when installing this server
